scope: Local compatible application and the allowed Supabase project; disposable QA accounts only.

checks.name: Actual invoice-route regression checks notify readiness only after required publication writes succeed
Successful extraction retry reuses the document and retries notification delivery without rewriting analysis data
Real database notification creation is idempotent
Repeated delivery preserves an existing read state
Other accounts cannot read or update the notification
Readiness and failure events have distinct stable identities
Browser individual read updates persisted data and the sidebar unread badge
Analysis filter hides the synthetic system notification
Browser Mark all read clears the badge and persists after refresh
Unread filter shows the no-matching-items state after refresh

limits: This implements in-app analysis updates, not scheduled renewal reminders, vendor-response alerts or notification emails.
Notification storage failures are logged without changing the saved analysis result. Invoice successful retries also retry event delivery.
